Step 3 of 5 · Quick questions

Let's size it up

Tap your answers. Answers outlined in gold are what most families pick.

📏 Good to know: a typical backyard pool starts around 32 × 15 ft. That's about two parking spaces long.
Length (ft)
Width (ft)
♨️ Spa sizes: most spas are about 7 ft across inside and fit about 6–8 adults. A 7 × 7 fits about 6, an 8 × 8 about 8, and a 7 × 9 a few more.
☀️ Sun shelf: a shallow ledge about 8 × 10 ft fits 2 lounge chairs in a few inches of water.
🏠 Leave some room: plan on keeping the pool about 5 ft from the house and fences, and off any easements (strips the city or utility company uses). Your city or HOA sets the exact rules, and your builder will check them.
